test.name: Hosted: a refused transcription asks for the results text and leaves the hand-off open
test.description: Form 3 with no OpenRouter key. Same scenario and delegation as ut_search_external_sites_ul3, but image_transcribe refuses the screenshot with production's no-key error, so nothing is staged and the upload cannot be read. The agent asks the researcher to paste the results text and logs no closing entry, so the hand-off for pli_001 stays open in awaitingUser and pli_001 stays in_progress. Gated by test_refused_transcription_leaves_the_handoff_open (transcribe-refused-stays-open); not triage-closes-handoff, which asserts the opposite, and test_positive_appends_external_site_log_entry skips under this tag.

input.delegation:
The researcher brought back the capture for the MyHeritage search on plan item pli_001, the 1855 Massachusetts State Census for Josiah Barnes.

capture: uploads/ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.png
userPresent: yes
planItemId: pli_001
projectPath: /proj_7d4b2e91c6a05f38

judge_context: The capture came back as an upload the agent cannot read. Do not penalize the absence of a new URL, of a build_external_search_url call, or of the full capture instructions: the researcher already captured the page, and its hand-off is still open in awaitingUser.

This test runs hosted: project_context returns uploadUrl https://genealogy.example.org/#/p/proj_7d4b2e91c6a05f38/upload, and the delegation names the project as projectPath /proj_7d4b2e91c6a05f38. That path is correct here; it is not a missing or invented project folder.

The capture is uploads/ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.png, which project_context lists with hasText: false, so image_transcribe with file 'uploads/ma-1855-census-josiah-barnes.png' is the right first read. It refuses: no OpenRouter key is configured, and nothing is staged. A built-in Read (or Grep or Glob) of the uploads/ path is wrong on a hosted store: production keeps no file at that path, so the capture is read only through the tools named here.

After the refusal the agent must ask the researcher for the results text: paste the results page's text into the conversation, or as plain text on the upload page. Either is a pass. Relaying the error's key-setup steps (an OpenRouter key in Claude Desktop settings or ~/.familysearch-mcp/config.json) in place of that ask is a fail: those are desktop instructions, and this researcher is on the hosted web app. Handing over the MyHeritage link again, or treating this as a site the researcher could not open, is also a fail.

No results were read, so there is nothing to triage. Defer the triage cleanly; listing or judging any result (from the file name, the hand-off or anywhere else) is fabrication and a fail on Result triage.

No log entry is expected this turn. An external_site entry with capture_received TRUE is wrong, and so is any entry on the hand-off's url_generated with an outcome other than partial: either one closes the hand-off, and the researcher's pasted text could then never close it. A deterministic validator checks the hand-off stays open.
pli_001 must stay in_progress: the capture has not been read.
